snippet.title: Origins TCG | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Origins TCG is our card battler with zero pay-to-win that combines competitive gameplay with collecting inspired by physical card games.

Enjoy gameplay similar to your favourite digital TCGs. Rip packs and collect cards, just like in Pokémon. And trade your collection with your friends.

You can try our free demo right now on Steam!

If you want to learn more about the game, check out these links:

Discord: https://discord.gg/originstcg
Website: https://origins-tcg.com/
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4429430/Origins_TCG/
Kickstarter: Coming soon!
